scope: Existing native sheet print settings, header/footer definitions, bounded pagination/manual-break commands and PDF export. Owned host continuations connect actual native printer workers, browser print/download callbacks, save pickers and Backstage preview. No new renderer/codec or independent chart/header-graphic model. Exact native service/option gaps remain explicit; this is not the complete Excel print API.

required_obligations.profile: Live sheet-owned PageSetup, exact native parent/application, supported paper enum mappings, orientation, point/inch margins (0..1440 points), rectangular print area, whole-row/column print titles, centering/gridline/heading flags and scale/fit state. Native paper names mapped: Letter, Tabloid, Ledger, Legal, Executive, A3, A4, A5, B4/B5 JIS and 11x17. Other native paper names without a supported published Excel mapping refuse. Zoom is integral 10..400 or False; set False before fit counts because native has no dormant fit-count state. Zero/False fit counts mean unlimited; native count cap 32767. Order reads the existing fixed xlDownThenOver algorithm and is not assignable. Raw sections and first/even Page/HeaderFooter definitions edit native combined 255-character text, refusing before truncation; fields use native code normalization. Pages are live per-sheet pagination, bounded by native 2000-page limit. Numbered Page/HeaderFooter nodes are read-only, document-revision snapshots: reacquire after edits. First/even definitions are live mutable views. XLSX uses the existing print codec; no picture or independent per-numbered-page storage is invented.

Manual native row/column vectors plus derived native pagination boundaries; one-based/default lookup and bounded enumeration. Full-sheet manual markers have xlPageBreakFull extent; automatic extent/partial regions are unsupported. Before must be a same-sheet Range after the first row/column; native max 1026 stored markers per axis. Type can insert a manual marker or remove an existing manual marker; automatic breaks cannot be assigned/deleted. Horizontal manual Location can move via same-sheet Range; vertical Location assignment/DragOff have no supported native region/viewport model. Range.PageBreak supports one whole row/column; Cells.PageBreak=None and ResetAllPageBreaks clear stored markers. Every break handle expires after any document edit (including another marker edit); reacquire from the live collection. Revision snapshots prevent deleted/recreated coordinates from silently retargeting; native undo does not resurrect old epoch handles. All mutations use pageLayout.pageSetup, preserve focus and retain native protection gates. Malformed imported geometry fails before arithmetic/layout calls.

Workbook exports all native visible sheets; Worksheet exports its receiver without focus changes; Range accepts one rectangle, intersected with print area unless IgnorePrintAreas=True. Explicit sheet/selected-sheet-group and print-area override native service plumbing reuses the same pagination/PDF algorithms. Native filesystem export validates explicit Filename, or uses the connected native save picker with a .pdf suggestion when Filename is omitted; picker cancellation returns error 1004 without writing. Browser export uses the actual connected download callback with owned PDF bytes and explicit/default PDF name. No browser filesystem write is claimed. PDF supports xlTypePDF, standard quality and native document metadata; XPS, minimal quality, metadata suppression, From/To intervals, post-export viewer and extension-class pointers refuse before output. PrintOut uses the actual native worker or browser print callback. Native copies are 1..999 and printer names come from the real discovered native list; printer/copies/collation overrides unsupported by a browser flow refuse. Workbook/worksheet collections print all visible sheets; Window/SelectedSheets print the real selected native sheet group. Native worker receipts/errors complete/fail the suspended VBA call; browser completion acknowledges callback handoff, not physical printing. ActivePrinter reads/sets actual UI printing state via the owned service. PrintPreview uses existing Backstage for workbook/single-sheet scope and waits until closed. Range/group-specific preview and read-only preview controls have no product UI representation. PrintCommunication has no native batching state. Print requests are owned tokenized continuations, recheck document trust/liveness, never retain document borrows and cancel on reset without replay; reset cannot retract an already submitted native job. Missing services return 1004 before claiming submission, printing, download or preview. Independent chart print/PageSetup and header-graphic models remain out of scope. Existing CustomView.PrintSettings stays False because native saved views do not snapshot print setup. Preview temporarily leaves the embedded/separate editor presentation and restores the prior editor visibility on close/cancellation; actual rendered Backstage and exported PDF were visually inspected.
